description: Lists the publications on Opedd with their article counts, licences, prices and sample articles. Filters: category (case-insensitive substring), min_articles and verified status. Public; no key needed.

category.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on publisher category (e.g. 'finance', 'AI').

min_articles.description: Filter to publishers with at least this many licensable articles.

verified.description: 'true' to show only verified publishers (default), 'false' for unverified.

name: publisher_directory
title: List publishers
